# JetBrains Mono Nerd Font Mono

Bundled from the [Nerd Fonts v3.5.1 release](https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/tag/v3.5.1),
archive `JetBrainsMono.tar.xz`.

Includes regular, bold, italic, and bold italic styles. The regular font's
PostScript name is `JetBrainsMonoNFM-Regular`, matching the iTerm2 profile.
`init.zsh` installs these files into `~/Library/Fonts` on macOS; Linux skips them.

The upstream archive was verified against its GitHub SHA-256 digest:
`04d5e8f903693f9dd13e16f867e994834e681eb3c72c0d337a770dcda09010cf`.
`SHA256SUMS` records the extracted files' hashes; `OFL.txt` contains the license.

To update, extract the same four styles and license from a verified official
release, then update this version and `SHA256SUMS`. Keep the filenames and
PostScript names compatible with the installer and iTerm2 profile.
